Protesters also called for the immediate release of all hostages remaining in Gaza, criticizing the government for not ending the war sooner. On 3 July 2025, dozens Israelis protested at the entrance to Nir Oz (Beer Sheva, HaDarom) ahead of Prime Minister Netanyahu's visit to the town. Protesters spoke out against Netanyahu, accusing him of abandoning Nir Oz and the hostages, and also of using the visit to 'exploit the kibbutz's grief and dishonor the memory of those murdered.' Protesters also called for the release of hostages. This was Netanyahu's first visit to Nir Oz since 7 October 2023, when about a quarter of the residents of Nir Oz were taken hostage or killed by Hamas militants.
